title: Spectral Properties of Zero-Divisor Graphs of Truncated Polynomial Rings
summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring with identity and let $Z^{\ast}(R)$ denote the set of nonzero zero-divisors of $R$. The \emph{zero-divisor graph} $ \varGamma(R)$ is the simple graph with vertex set $V( \varGamma(R))=Z^{\ast}(R)$, where two distinct vertices$x,y\in Z^{\ast}(R)$ are adjacent if and only if $xy=0$ in $R$.
